user.title: Basic Settings
user.description: Specify connection parameters for the Narodny Monitoring service.

select_sensors.title: Select Sensors
select_sensors.description: Select sensors whose values will be sent to the Narodny Monitoring service.

assign_ids.title: Assign Metric IDs
assign_ids.description: For each selected sensor, specify the metric ID (e.g., T1, H1, P1).

optimistic.title: Optimistic mode
optimistic.description: Select sensors whose current readings should be sent every time, even without a new device report. Numeric validation still applies. Selected sensors use the send time; other sensors use their last report time (last_reported). Deselect a sensor to disable optimistic mode.

error.no_ids_specified: Specify an ID for at least one sensor.
